title: the ReBAR language — the option labels decoded at the package floor; the founder's Auto byte-true; the grayout operand named
instruments: lab/fw50-rebarlang.py (lang/pair/nulllang/selftest/manifest), composing frozen fw49 machinery (and through it fw37/fw43); the honest label index is the FORWARD map from the measured package floor
laws: L1 labels-over-guesses: a label is claimed only when the forward map from a MEASURED floor reproduces it and the floor->anchor count matches (1280 + anchor text) — both directions honest
L2 anchors-before-marks: every header/floor/qid/vsid/voff is extracted live; the four sisters reproduce the ring-49 crown or the instrument refuses loud
L3 zero writes: the instrument reads; this register is the single write of the ring
L4 compose-on-frozen: fw49 imported, never rewritten; entry_before used only where its semantics are proven (the mis-step census)

PR-1.claim: the forward map from the measured floor reaches the anchor in EXACTLY 1280 steps on b550w2-3644 (tok = ordinal + 1; HII StringId 1 = the language name 'English')

PR-2.claim: the ReBAR ONE_OF vocabulary is {0x00: tok4 'Disabled', 0x01: tok5 'Auto'} with no third option

PR-3.claim: Above4gDecode/SriovSupport/CsmSupport are {0x00: 'Disabled', 0x01: 'Enabled'} (tok 4 / tok 3) — ReBAR is the ONLY Auto-valued question in the decoding family

PR-4.claim: the grayout operand qid 0x361 is a hidden NUMERIC u8 bound to varstore 4 offset 0 (prompt tok 0)

PR-6.claim: varstore 48 is 'SecureVarPresent', 6 bytes, GUID 7B59104A-C00D-4158-87FF-F04D6396A915, and the two extra WIFI II questions read SecureVarPresent[0]/[4] — ring 49's 'WIFI questions' reading is REFUTED
PR-6.verdict: hit — ring 49's 'WIFI questions' reading REFUTED and kept visible (rings 45/47/48 precedent)

PR-7.claim: the language (toks 1..8 + the sisters' option vocabulary) is identical across all three acquisitions

PR-8.claim: ring 49's SCSU reading is CORRECTED: toks 3/4/5 are plain UTF-16 at the package floor; the failure was the unvalidated backward walk (empty-entry skips)
PR-8.verdict: hit — ring 49's SCSU reading CORRECTED, never rewritten (L3 of ring 49)

package_3644.note: one standard EFI_HII_PACKAGE_HEADER (Type 0x04 STRINGS, LanguageWindow all-zero, StringId 1 = the language name) directly above the forms' closing ENDs; SIBT blocks are ID-LESS utf16z runs (marker 0x14 = the AMI variant of SIBT_STRING_UCS2): block ordinal k IS StringId k+1

base_law: tok = ordinal + 1; verified by the forward count floor->anchor = 1280 with the anchor text 'Above 4G Decoding' (tok 1281)

grayout_3644.reading: GRAY_OUT_IF(SystemAccess[0] == 1): the ReBAR option grays out for restricted sessions (the AMI TSE session privilege variable); the precise value semantics stay vendor-code territory (open question)

pair_laws.law: the language (toks + the sisters' vocabularies) is INVARIANT across all three acquisitions; the only mover stays the grayout operand's qid 0x361 <-> 0x35F (ring 49's pair law, now at the language level)

corrections.ring49_scsu_reading: REFUTED and corrected: toks 3/4/5 are plain UTF-16 at the package floor; the ring-49 failure mode was its own backward walker (entry_before skips empty entries; the unvalidated 1400-step anchor_table walk lands in machine code) — measured 111 mis-steps over 2000 entries, 111 empty entries
corrections.ring49_wifi_reading: REFUTED: the two extra WIFI II questions read SecureVarPresent[0]/[4] (varstore 48, Secure Boot variable-presence), not wifi questions
corrections.register_ring49: never rewritten (frozen registers are read, never edited); the corrections live here

day0_day1.vocabulary_law: Resize BAR Support offers {Disabled, Auto} — NO Enabled: Auto is the only positive value; 'il détecte mal alors que c'est en auto' is byte-true and the Auto heuristic is the ONLY path to engagement
auto_chain: Above 4G Decoding must be Enabled (0x01) — else the ReBAR question is SUPPRESSED entirely (Above4gDecode==0)
CSM disabled in the Boot section (the vendor help's own NOTE; CsmSupport = 0x00)
a ReBAR-capable GPU on the bus
the setup session unrestricted (SystemAccess[0] != 1, else the option GRAYS OUT)
live_check: omarchy-firmware diag-gpu -> gpu-bar1-small if BAR1 <= 256 MiB (ReBAR off)
cat /proc/iomem -> GPU BARs above the 4 GB line
day0_day1.dump_row: the language is invariant under the 16/09 flash (pair law); the stock NVRAM Setup bytes 0x1BA/0x1BB decide the chain and are readable by fw49's axis mode on the dump

open_questions: the precise value semantics of SystemAccess (0 vs 1 vs 2: administrator/user/view-only) live in the AMI TSE binary, not the IFR — named but not semantically decoded
the SecureVarPresent rows the WIFI II adds ([0] and [4]) name no specific variable in the IFR — the 6-byte bitmap's field order is vendor-code territory
whether CSM's own form lives in another formset (ring 49's note) — the question RECORD is in the walked bodies (qid 0x2900); only its DISPLAY page is open
